instruction.text: Match the stories to the correct equations.

atoms.a: 5 years ago, Dylan was 8 years old. How old is Dylan now?
Nora has 9 toy trains. She gives 4 to Claire. How many toy trains does Nora have now?

instruction.text: Match the stories to the correct equations.

atoms.b: Joe has 8 books. He buys 3 more books. How many books does Joe have now?
Mira is 8 years old. How old will she be in 3 years?
Kim is 13 years old. Her sister is 4 years younger. How old is Kim’s sister?
Ed has 13 chips. He eats 4 of them. How many chips does Ed have now?
